CPS I/O Buffered

Provides BufferedReader and BufferedWriter that wrap any AsyncStream with application-level buffering for efficient line-oriented and chunked I/O.

Imports

../runtime, ../eventloop, streams

Types

BufferedReader = ref object
  stream*: AsyncStream
BufferedWriter = ref object
  stream*: AsyncStream
